        return 0

    return same + diff

def shell_sort(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    gap = n // 2
    while gap > 0:
        for i in range(gap, n):
            temp = arr[i]
            j = i
            while j >= gap and arr[j - gap] > temp:
                arr[j] = arr[j - gap]
                j -= gap
            arr[j] = temp
        gap //= 2
    return arr

def find_substring_positions(text, substring):
    positions = []
    start = 0
    while True:
        start = text.find(substring, start)
        if start == -1:
            break
        positions.append((start, start + len(substring)))
        start += len(substring)
    return positions if positions else None

    if feature not in df.columns or target not in df.columns:
        raise ValueError("If specified columns are not in the provided DataFrame.")
    X = df[[feature]]
    y = df[target]
    model = LinearRegression().fit(X, y)
    residuals = np.abs(y - model.predict(X))
    indices = heapq.nlargest(n, range(len(residuals)), key=residuals.__getitem__)
    return indices, model

# Constants
WORD_LIST = ["sample", "text", "contains", "several", "words", "including"]

def task_func(n_sentences):
    sentences = []
    for _ in range(n_sentences):
        sentence = ' '.join(random.choices(WORD_LIST, k=random.randint(3, 5)))
        sentence += '.'
        sentences.append(sentence.lower())
    cleaned = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9\s.]', '', ' '.join(sentences))
    return cleaned.replace(' .', '.')

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(sales_data):
    months = sales_data['Month']
    product_sales = sales_data.set_index('Month').T
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    for col in product_sales.columns:
        mean = product_sales[col].mean()
        std = product_sales[col].std()
        ax.plot(months, product_sales[col], label=col)
        ax.fill_between(months, product_sales[col] - std, product_sales[col] + std, alpha=0.3)
    ax.set_xlabel('Month')
    ax.set_ylabel('Sales')
    ax

def task_func(directory, n):
